## Q. I want to change the character / icon shown in omikuji results

### Changing a specific omikuji

![](../../../../images/22_Character-1792766198383.webp)

- This setting is common to Comment Events, Timer Events, and Action Sets.
- You can change it under "Omikuji Settings" > Character / Color.
  - This item is not shown when Character Mode is OFF.
  - For details, see [Q. I want to show the character / I want to hide the character and show only the speech bubble](/template/en/faq/22_Character/faq_2202_BubbleOnly.md).

### Changing all omikuji at once

![](../../../../images/22_Character-1792766210931.webp)

- This setting is common to Comment Events, Timer Events, and Action Sets.
- Click the "Change All Characters" or "Change Character" button in each section.
- In "Character Change Settings", specify the character you want and click "Apply Change".
